name: MwpBench
description: MwpBench is a benchmark of Math Word Problems designed to comprehensively evaluate mathematical reasoning abilities of large language models. It aggregates ten datasets covering K-12, college, and competition level math problems to assess performance across a wide range of mathematical topics and difficulty levels.
reputation: A useful math reasoning benchmark that aggregates several established datasets, but it is less widely standardized than major single-suite math benchmarks.
notes: Includes 10 datasets such as GSM8K and MATH; used to evaluate LLMs fine-tuned on MathScaleQA dataset.
